title: Negation: ne…pas / jamais
summary: Standard negation wraps the conjugated verb: ne + verb + pas. Use n’ before a vowel sound. Jamais means never. Ne…que means only.
full_explanation: Standard negation wraps the conjugated verb: ne + verb + pas. Use n’ before a vowel sound. Jamais means never. Ne…que means only.

examples.french: Nous ne mangeons pas de viande.
